title: Did Britain Destroy Itself in 1914? | Peter Hitchens
adapt: The 'did X destroy itself' verdict structure — arguing a great power's own choices, not an external enemy, caused its ruin — maps directly to a video asking whether an institution's own choices about AI (not AI itself) will prove to be what breaks it.
why: Not about AI, but a historical-causation verdict argument is a transferable register; the thesis has no date anchor and stays debatable indefinitely.
